name: Combat Experience, Greater (Combat)
body:
Your accumulated martial knowledge is so profound and innate at this point that its benefits last longer.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +14, Combat Experience, Improved Combat Experience, and 14 ranks in either Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier).

Benefit: If you use Combat Experience to gain a competence bonus to an attack roll, it applies to any two attack rolls you make that round. You choose at the time of your attack roll if you wish to apply the competence bonus to that attack.

If you use Combat Experience to gain a circumstance bonus to your AC, it applies against any two attack rolls made against you that round. You choose at the time of the attack roll if you wish to apply the circumstance bonus to your AC.

If you use Combat Experience to gain a competence bonus to your saving throw roll, it applies on any two such saving throw rolls you make that round. You choose at the time of the rolling a saving throw if you wish to apply the competence bonus to your roll.

Special: You no longer have to wait any additional rounds before you can use Combat Experience again after using it during any round but you are still limited to using two daily uses of Combat Experience at most during any round.
